about_the_game:
From the creators of the world-famous RPG Maker series comes the newest installment in the Action Game Maker line!
Compared to its predecessors, this latest version offers a high-performance toolset for serious game creation while still retaining the hallmark accessibility of the Maker series. Thanks to its FSM-based visual scripting system, you can create a wide range of games without programming knowledge.

If “I want to make a 2D game like the ones trending right now, but had to give up because programming wasn’t for me…” applies, then this is the perfect tool for you.

◆ Features

  • FSM (Finite State Machine) Visual Scripting: Easily create without programming skills

  • Full access to Godot Engine’s 2D features

  • Exclusive built-in systems added to Godot Engine, including:

    • Database system

    • Scene transition system

    • Save/Load system

    • Damage and invincibility systems

    • Sound and music management system

    • Bullet-based projectile system

    • Bullet Hell Generation System (Added in ver. 1.2.0)

    • Screen & object visual filter effects

    • Local multiplayer support for up to 8 players with optimized multiplayer camera

    • Support for Presets and templated objects

    • Over 1,000 sample assets (graphics, audio, animations, particles)

  • Dedicated community site: RPG Maker Guild

◆ What is FSM Visual Scripting?

Unlike flow-based visual scripting tools designed for programmers, our FSM-based visual scripting system is created specifically for non-programmers.
Each “state” (such as Walk or Jump) can be expanded with human-readable “actions,” making it possible to control characters without needing to understand the engine’s internal functions.

Moreover, ACTION GAME MAKER’s visual scripting is genre-agnostic. In the previous title, Pixel Game Maker MV, creators built not only platformers and Metroidvania-style games but also action-adventures, puzzles, card games, RPGs, and much more.

◆ Utilize All 2D Features of Godot Engine 4.4.1

Godot Engine is a powerful game engine rivaling Unity and Unreal.
With ACTION GAME MAKER, you can fully access all of its 2D features—dynamic lights and shadows, shader-based water effects, and other advanced techniques seen in today’s indie hits.

Full support for GDScript programming is retained, so whether you combine it with visual scripting or make something just in code, you’re enabled to create virtually any 2D game possible with Godot Engine.

◆ Start Creating Right Away!

Beyond Godot’s standard features, ACTION GAME MAKER comes with tools specially designed in the spirit of RPG Maker, such as:

  • A database system

  • Scene transition tools

  • And many more functions optimized for visual scripting

It also includes:

  • 400+ sound effects and music tracks

  • 400+ images

  • 200+ 2D bone animations

All perfectly suited for creating side-view 2D action games!
No need to search for plugins, extensions, or external assets—you can start making your game, from  jump action or Metroidvania-style, immediately.

◆ Support You Can Rely On

  • Official Discord & RPG Maker Guild: Tutorials, manuals, Q&A forums, and user community support.

  • No royalties, ever: Only the purchase price of the software—sell your games freely without worrying about revenue share.

  • Multi-platform export: Deploy your games to Windows, Web (HTML5), and Android.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 530
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, AMD Ryzen 5 3400 or more
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 , AMD Radeon RX 5500XT or more
